scholarships.name: WBJEE Tuition Fee Waiver (TFW)
scholarships.details: 100% tuition fee waiver allotted via Centralized WBJEE counseling for meritorious students with family income under ₹2.5 Lakhs per annum.

scholarships.name: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means (SVMCM)
scholarships.details: State govt scholarship offering ₹60,000 per year for B.Tech students scoring 60%+ in 10+2 with family income below ₹2.5 Lakhs.

scholarships.name: Sikh Community Freeship
scholarships.details: Students belonging to the Sikh Community may apply for up to 50% freeship on tuition fees with community verification.

scholarships.name: JIS Group Institutional Scholarship
scholarships.details: 20% tuition fee waiver for students who completed earlier degree/diploma from any JIS Group institution.

scholarships.name: North East Region Student Scholarship
scholarships.details: Special scholarship of ₹40,000 for students from the North East states enrolling in B.Tech programs.

scholarships.name: Government Portals Supported
scholarships.details: National Scholarship Portal (NSP), Kanyashree (K3), Aikyashree, OASIS, Pragati & Saksham (AICTE), and Vidyalakshmi loan support.

faqs.question: What is the fee for B.Tech Computer Science (CSE) in 1st semester?
faqs.answer: For B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) and CSE-AIML, the 1st semester fee is ₹108,125. The total 4-year fee across 8 semesters is ₹7,74,900.

faqs.question: What is the fee for B.Tech Information Technology (IT) or CSBS in 1st semester?
faqs.answer: For B.Tech IT, CST, and CSBS, the 1st semester fee is ₹96,375. The total 4-year fee across 8 semesters is ₹6,80,900.

faqs.question: What is the fee for B.Tech Electronics and Communication (ECE) in 1st semester?
faqs.answer: For B.Tech ECE, the 1st semester fee is ₹92,625. The total 4-year fee across 8 semesters is ₹6,50,900.

faqs.question: What is the hostel fee at Narula Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: Hostel charges are ₹6,500 per month (6 months = ₹39,000) plus a one-time admission charge of ₹5,000, making the total payable at admission ₹44,000. Separate hostels are provided for boys and girls.

faqs.question: What is the uniform fee?
faqs.answer: One-time uniform fee is ₹6,000 for B.Tech, BCA, BBA, and Diploma students, and ₹2,500 for MCA & M.Tech students.

faqs.question: What are the required documents during admission reporting?
faqs.answer: Required documents: WBJEE/JEE Rank Card, Allotment Letter, 10th Admit Card, 10th & 12th Marksheets, Domicile Certificate, Caste Certificate (if applicable), Income Certificate, Medical Fitness Certificate, 5 Photos, Aadhaar, and Anti-Ragging Undertakings.

faqs.question: Can I pay the fees in installments or avail EMI?
faqs.answer: Yes, semester-wise payment flexibility, education loan assistance, and EMI options through partner banks are available.
